findings.name: duplicates
findings.message: Found 70 duplicate mechanism signature(s) across 70 distinct location(s). Distinct fault paths can legitimately share a (detector, observable) signature on multi-round circuit-level DEMs (signature collision); if this DEM was assembled by concatenating sub-circuit DEMs, the same fault path may instead be double-counted. The decoder-facing probability for a shared signature is the XOR-folded value p_eff = p1*(1-p2) + p2*(1-p1) (iterated for 3+), shown per group in the counter-example. 70 of 70 group(s) are mixed (mechanisms with different decomposition structures share only the merged signature — distinct fault paths, not true duplicates).

findings.name: correctability
findings.message: Found 1 syndrome(s) across 1 distinct location(s) that map to more than one distinct observable set. The decoder cannot determine which logical observable was flipped from the measurement outcome alone.
